description: Background scans for cardvision make-composites: 207 material scans from Poly Haven (polyhaven.com), each published under CC0 1.0. This file holds no image, only where each scan is described, its size and its SHA-256. cardvision fetch-textures downloads the 1K JPEG color map of each scan and checks it against the hash. "listing" is the source's own description of an asset's files; the download link is read from it when fetching, and the hash decides whether the file is the one recorded here. "split" keeps the scans of training scenes apart from those of validation scenes; "category" is the source's category the scan was listed under. Poly Haven is not affiliated with this project.
